nameEn: Forging, pressing, stamping and roll-forming of metal; powder metallurgy
description: This class includes the forging, pressing, stamping and roll-forming of metal and manufacture of sintered metal articles.
includes: forging of metal: manufacture of iron and steel forgings and non-ferrous metal forgings
pressing, stamping and roll-forming of metal
powder metallurgy: manufacture of sintered metal articles by compression of metallic powders (gears, bushings, bearings, etc.)
manufacture of metal valves and fittings by forging
excludes: manufacture of metal in primary forms, see 2410, 2420
manufacture of metal door and window frames by forging, see 2511
